name: Wright Flyer
description: The Wrights' spruce-and-muslin biplane that made the first controlled, powered, heavier-than-air flights at Kitty Hawk on 17 December 1903 — twelve seconds and 36 metres on the first attempt. Displayed at the Smithsonian.

name: Enigma Machine
description: German rotor cipher machine whose military traffic Polish and then British cryptanalysts at Bletchley Park broke — an intelligence triumph credited with shortening the Second World War and seeding modern computing.
